d: We are currently seeking a dynamic, passionate, and self-motivated Bartender to join our team at Alto Lounge and bring creativity, energy, and personality to our beverage experience.

As a Bartender, you will be responsible for preparing and serving high-quality beverages while delivering warm, engaging, and personalized service. You will play an important role in creating the vibrant atmosphere of Alto Lounge through excellent product knowledge, creative presentation, and memorable guest interactions.
q: You should ideally have a diploma or vocational qualification in Hospitality or Food & Beverage, with a minimum of one year of experience in bar operations, preferably within a hotel, upscale lounge, or high-volume bar environment.
An excellent command of spoken and written English is essential, together with strong guest-service, communication, and interpersonal skills. Knowledge of additional languages would be an advantage.

You should possess good knowledge of wines, spirits, liqueurs, cocktails, mocktails, and beverage service, together with practical bartending and mixology skills. Experience in cocktail preparation, creative presentation, suggestive selling, and premium beverage service would be highly desirable.
The ideal candidate will be hands-on, energetic, outgoing, and guest-focused, with a genuine passion for beverages, people, and delivering memorable bar experiences.

You should have a confident and engaging personality, a positive attitude, and the ability to connect naturally with guests while maintaining professionalism. You will thrive in a fast-paced and vibrant lounge environment, remaining calm and organized during busy service periods while maintaining strong attention to detail.
You should demonstrate the following competencies
r: li
Prepare and serve cocktails, mocktails, wines, spirits, and other beverages consistently according to established recipes and service standards.
li
Provide engaging, professional, and personalized service while creating a welcoming and lively bar experience for every guest.
li
Set up the bar and ensure all mise en place, garnishes, glassware, equipment, and beverage stocks are ready before service.
li
Maintain excellent knowledge of the beverage menu, signature cocktails, premium spirits, wines, promotions, and special offers .
li
Recommend beverages based on guest preferences and confidently explain cocktail ingredients, flavors, and preparation styles.
li
Support revenue generation through suggestive selling and upselling of signature cocktails, premium beverages, and promotional offerings .
li
Contribute creative ideas for new cocktails, seasonal beverages, and innovative drink presentations to enhance the Alto Lounge experience.
li
Maintain cleanliness, organization, and hygiene of the bar, equipment, glassware, and surrounding work areas throughout service.
li
Monitor beverage stock levels and support proper stock rotation, storage, and control to minimize unnecessary wastage.
li
Work closely with the bar and service teams to ensure fast, accurate, and seamless service during busy periods.
li
Handle guest requests and feedback professionally while maintaining a friendly, confident, and engaging approach.
li
Support the overall energy, atmosphere, and guest experience of Alto Lounge , particularly during busy evenings, special events, and promotional nights.
li
Consistently demonstrate professionalism, teamwork, and a genuine passion for mixology and beverage service .

d: Position: Basic Science Instructor (Physics, Mathematics, and Scientific Terminology)

We are seeking a dedicated and engaging Basic Science Instructor to join our educational team in Al-Kharj. The ideal candidate will design and deliver high-quality lessons that teach physics concepts, mathematical reasoning, and precise scientific terminology in a clear and accessible manner. This role emphasizes active learning, student engagement, and a supportive classroom environment.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Physics, Mathematics, Education, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
Teaching certification or licensure preferred; relevant classroom experience in science or math education required.
Strong command of physics concepts, mathematics, and scientific terminology; ability to translate technical content into accessible instruction.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
Ability to work effectively with students, parents, and teammates in a culturally diverse environment.
Proficiency in Arabic and English is highly desirable.
r: li
Plan, prepare, and deliver comprehensive lessons in physics, mathematics, and scientific terminology aligned with curriculum standards.
li
Explain complex concepts using accessible language and real-world applications to students with varying levels of background knowledge.
li
Develop instructional materials, activities, and assessments that promote critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
li
Assess student progress, provide constructive feedback, and maintain accurate records of achievement and attendance.
li
Differentiate instruction to accommodate diverse learning needs and provide additional support as needed.
li
Foster a safe, inclusive, and respectful classroom environment that encourages curiosity and collaboration.
li
Collaborate with colleagues to integrate cross-disciplinary activities and improve overall instructional quality.
li
Incorporate technology and educational tools to enhance learning outcomes and engagement.
li
Participate in professional development opportunities and contribute to school-wide initiatives.
x: Professional development opportunities and ongoing learning.
Supportive work environment with collaborative teams.
Health benefits and retirement plan, as applicable.

Please submit your resume, a cover letter outlining your teaching philosophy and relevant experience, and any supporting certifications to the indicated contact email. Include your eligibility to work in Saudi Arabia and your preferred start date.

d: Fueled by passion, KAYALI was founded in 2018 by beauty mogul and fragrance fanatic, Mona Kattan. Translating to ‘my imagination’ in Arabic, KAYALI provides a modern fragrance experience inspired by Mona’s rich Middle Eastern heritage and the art of layering scents to help you create your mood; where sharing scents is a ritual and smelling good is both an act of goodwill and self-love.

Mona collaborates with some of the world’s most renowned perfumers and sources the finest ingredients to create unique juices that are infinitely memorable, long-lasting, and cruelty-free. Each luxurious fragrance is an ode to true craftsmanship and tells a special story, from the addictive notes to the multi-faceted jeweled bottles.

To make everyone feel like the diamond they are! To build a global community of fragrance lovers through the power of scent and by providing them with the most innovative & luxurious fragrances, education and sharing our Middle Eastern fragrance rituals with the world.

The role acts as KAYALI’s production point of contact for outsourced campaign production and coordinates in-house cutdowns and retouching.
r: li
Manage direct reports, including hiring, onboarding, one-to-ones, performance reviews, development and addressing performance concerns.
li
Receive approved briefs from the Traffic Controller and confirm requirements are complete before scheduling.
li
Own production and post-production schedules, assignments, team capacity and deadlines across concurrent projects.
li
Own and control the department budget, including production budgets, freelance crew, vendors and external editor bookings.
li
Oversee the outsourced campaign producer’s agreed milestones, deliverables and asset handovers.
li
Track assets through editing, retouching, review, approval and final delivery.
li
Consolidate feedback, resolve conflicting instructions and assign revisions.
li
Coordinate review rounds and approvals with the Traffic Controller.
li
Flag changes outside the approved brief and their implications for timing, resources and cost.
li
Maintain production trackers, delivery records and clear processes for file organisation, backups and archiving.

Identify bottlenecks and improve workflows as the department grows.

Demonstrated experience hiring, developing and managing employee performance.
Proven ability to balance high volumes of work, competing priorities and multiple stakeholders.
Strong experience in resource planning, production budgets, vendor management and post-production scheduling.
Understanding of video, photography, editing, retouching and asset delivery workflows.
Calm judgement, clear communication and strong organisational skills.
